title:
cd /tmp/unvibe-latency-CrCiEu/worktrees/rv_5d3ea0db8f7f && git log --oneline -1 && python3 --version && cat > /tmp/critic_obsfold_$$.py <<'EOF'
import sys, time, socket, threading, http.client, io
sys.path.insert(0, "src")
from urllib3.connection import _normalize_header_value, _normalize_header_values, _OBSOLETE_FOLD_RE
import urllib3

def parse(raw):
    return http.client.parse_headers(io.BytesIO(raw))

cases = {
 "crlf fold": b"X: a\r\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "bare LF fold": b"X: a\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "bare LF both": b"X: a\n b\n\n",
 "fold at start": b"X:\r\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "fold at start sp": b"X: \r\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "ws-only continuation last": b"X: a\r\n \r\nY: 1\r\n\r\n",
 "bare CR": b"X: a\r b\r\n\r\n",
 "CR LF mix": b"X: a\r\r\n b\r\n\r\n",
 "non-ascii": b"X: caf\xe9\r\n b\r\n\r\n",
}
for k, raw in cases.items():
    m = parse(raw)
    before = m.items()
    after = _normalize_header_values(m)
    print(f"{k:28} before={before!r} after={after!r} msg={m.items()!r} defects={m.defects}")

# timing
for n in (10000, 20000, 40000, 80000):
    for label, v in (("ws run no fold", "a" + " "*n + "b\r\n c"),
                     ("many short runs", ("a "*n) + "\r\n c"),
                     ("ws run then fold", "a" + " "*n + "\r\n c"),
                     ("many folds", "a\r\n "* (n//4))):
        t=time.perf_counter(); _normalize_header_value(v); d=time.perf_counter()-t
        print(n, label, f"{d*1000:.2f}ms")

# end to end through socket
def serve(payload):
    s = socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0)); s.listen(1)
    def run():
        c,_ = s.accept()
        buf=b""
        while not buf.endswith(b"\r\n\r\n"): buf += c.recv(65536)
        c.sendall(payload); c.close(); s.close()
    threading.Thread(target=run, daemon=True).start()
    return s.getsockname()[1]
for label, payload in (
  ("bare LF fold", b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nSet-Cookie: a=1\n b=2\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"),
  ("leading fold", b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nSet-Cookie:\r\n a=1\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"),
  ("trailing empty fold", b"HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nSet-Cookie: a=1\r\n \r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"),
):
    port = serve(payload)
    with urllib3.HTTPConnectionPool("127.0.0.1", port) as p:
        try:
            r = p.request("GET", "/", retries=0)
            print(label, dict(r.headers), r._original_response.msg.items())
        except Exception as e:
            print(label, "EXC", repr(e))
EOF
python3 /tmp/critic_obsfold_$$.py
